title: 儿童食品销量增42%：CEO上调全年指引，2027年盈利拐点
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get right to this idea here of exactly where we go next.
segments.zh: 接下来我们该何去何从？

segments.en: When it comes to this growth story, 42% growth is great.
segments.zh: 关于增长故事，42%的增长非常可观。

segments.en: Can you sustain it? Yes, we can.
We have very resilient consumer demand for our products, and we're resonating across baby all the way through kid, which is where our band meets consumers,
segments.zh: 我们的产品需求非常强劲，从婴儿到儿童都引起共鸣，这正是我们品牌与消费者的交汇点。

segments.en: and we're in a really good position to continue to grow. Such we raised our guidance for this year and our outlook for the future is increasing.
segments.zh: 我们处于有利位置，继续增长，因此上调了今年的指引，未来展望也在提升。

segments.en: When do we start to see, though, maybe a little bit more margin expansion here?
segments.zh: 那么，我们何时能看到更多利润率扩张？

segments.en: What's holding that back? Yeah, our business has been growing really fast on the baby snack side of our business, which is a great thing.
segments.zh: 是什么在阻碍？我们的婴儿零食业务增长非常快，这是好事。

segments.en: That mixes our business a little bit unfavorably in the very short term.
segments.zh: 这在短期内对业务组合有些不利影响。

segments.en: That's been a factor that we're facing, but we expect margins to continue to grow over the coming years.
segments.zh: 这是我们面临的一个因素，但我们预计未来几年利润率将继续增长。

segments.en: We talked about productivity investments that we'll be making in our plants and things like that.
segments.zh: 我们提到了将在工厂等方面进行的生产力**。

segments.en: Starting in 27 that are going to be significant, and we're very confident in this company's ability to drive really strong, long-term profitability,
segments.zh: 从27年开始，这些将非常显著，我们非常有信心这家公司能实现强劲的长期盈利。

segments.en: and we'll see a significant inflection upward in our adjusted EBITDA in 27.
segments.zh: 我们将在27年看到调整后EBITDA的显著向上拐点。

segments.en: So we're feeling really good about all that stuff or right where we want to be. Is there any concern?
segments.zh: 所以我们对这一切感觉非常好，或者正是我们想要的位置。有什么担忧吗？

segments.en: And I know when it comes to children's food, most parents aren't going to skimp, but we talk a lot in this show about certain consumers being a little bit stretched right now,
segments.zh: 我知道在儿童食品方面，大多数父母不会吝啬，但我们在这个节目中经常谈论某些消费者目前有些紧张。

segments.en: and whether that actually gets worse. I mean, what is kind of the buffer that you have?
segments.zh: 以及这种情况是否会变得更糟。我的意思是，你有什么缓冲？
